title: Board admin
notAdmin: You do not have access to this page
notAdminHint: {email} is signed in but is not an admin. Ask an admin to upgrade your account.
activeHint: Inactive records leave the board without losing their data
agentActiveHint: Inactive agents leave the agent ranking; their sales still count for their team
periodsHint: Edit the numbers, then press Save — nothing is written before that.
confirmDeleteTeam: Permanently delete team “{name}”? Its agents are kept but left without a team.
directorsHint: Their photos and names show on the quarter-end celebration's opening card. A standing list — add once, stays until you delete it.
confirmDeleteAgent: Permanently delete agent “{name}”? All their targets and sales go with them. Deactivating is usually better.
photoHint: JPG, PNG or WebP · opens in the photo studio before upload
demoHint: Browse every tab, view reports and download Excel files. Saving, deleting, uploading photos and sending celebrations are disabled for this account.
celebrateTitle: Show a celebration on the screens
celebrateHint: Appears full-screen right away on every open board — including the office display — and is logged in notifications. New deals are celebrated automatically; this is for manual congratulations.
celebrateDone: Done — the celebration for {name} is showing on every open screen.
quarterCelebrateHint: Fires a whole batch at once: a card for every team with any sales this quarter with its manager standing over the team photo, and a card for every agent with any sales (including managers who sold themselves). Best launched with the team watching the screen.
quarterCelebrateIntroHint: The first card, shown before any team — management's message with the directors' photos, and its own music.
quarterCelebrateIntroDefault: Proud of every one of you — here's to a new quarter of excellence and great teamwork.
quarterCelebrateTeamNote: Appreciation message for teams and their managers
quarterCelebrateAgentNoteDefault: 👏 Thank you for your great effort and contribution this quarter!
quarterCelebrateConfirm: A celebration will play for every qualifying team and every agent with sales — this can take several minutes on screen. Click again to confirm.
cutoutsHint: On team celebration cards, the manager stands over the team photo. Remove the photo background once here (automatically in the browser, or upload a ready transparent PNG). Changing the manager's original photo clears the old cutout.
cutoutsEmpty: No team managers set up yet.
cutoutReviewHint: Check the edges on the dark background — if there's white around the hair, raise edge cleanup.
cutoutEdgeHint: Stronger removes more white around the hair, but trims a little off the hair tips.
cutoutSaveHint: Background removed — press Save to keep it, or undo if you don't like it.
exportHint: A file with an instructions sheet plus Teams, Agents and Deals (the year’s deals). Teams and Agents match the Google Sheet. Use it as the template for entering the original data.
importHint: Updates existing rows and adds new ones by name — nothing is deleted. New deals are added to their quarter’s total; existing ones aren’t duplicated. Uploading doesn’t trigger celebrations.
photoType: Unsupported format — use JPG, PNG or WebP
changePasswordHint: At least 10 characters. Checked against a leaked-password database before saving.
passwordTooShort: Password is too short — at least 10 characters
passwordPwned: This password has appeared in {count} known data breaches — choose a different one
passwordCheckFailed: Couldn't check the password against the leak database (connection issue) — proceed at your own risk or try again later
leadsHint: Pick from the agents — a team can have several managers and supervisors; supervisors are optional.
leadsSame: The same person can't be both manager and supervisor of a team
transferHint: Moving an agent to another team doesn't change their current team's numbers: sales so far and this quarter's target stay with it, and new sales count for the new team.

storage.title: Storage used
storage.hint: Supabase database and photo usage, plus the GitHub code repository. Warning at 70%, critical at 90%.

alert.warn: Storage use passed 70% — take a backup and free up space soon.
alert.critical: Storage almost full (over 90%) — back up and free space now to keep the board fast.

storage.suggestBackup: Last backup: {when}. A monthly backup is recommended.
storage.suggestCleanup: After backing up, remove old notifications, snapshots and unused photos under “Free up space”.

meterHint.db: Numbers, notifications and daily snapshots. Free plan limit 500MB.
meterHint.files: Uploaded team and agent photos. Free plan limit 1GB.
meterHint.github: Code only; size is nearly constant. Recommended limit 1GB.

storage.githubUnavailable: Could not read the repository size right now (GitHub rate limit). Try later.
storage.backupHint: A single HTML file that opens in any browser, offline and without sign-in: team and agent rankings per quarter, notification log, daily snapshots, and the full raw data inside.
storage.backupDone: Backup downloaded. Keep it somewhere safe (e.g. Google Drive).
storage.excelToo: Or download the year’s Excel file from “Import & export”
storage.cleanHint: Deletes old supporting data only, to keep the board fast. Take a backup first.
storage.snapshotsNote: Trend charts and rank arrows for deleted quarters will no longer show.
storage.cleanSafe: Sales, targets, teams and agents are never deleted, and current-quarter data is protected.
storage.confirmCleanup: The selected data will be permanently deleted. Continue?
storage.confirmNoBackup: You have not downloaded a backup this session, and deletion is permanent. Continue without a backup?
storage.cleanDone: Done: removed {events} notifications, {snapshots} snapshots, {sync} sync entries, {photos} photos.
storage.demoNoClean: The demo account is view-only — cleanup is for admins.

importDealsSkipped: ({n} deals already existed and were skipped)

wipe.title: Clear data
wipe.hint: Before entering fresh data from scratch. A backup downloads to your device automatically first — if it fails, nothing is deleted.

scopeHint.sales: Targets, sales, deals, notifications and rank history. Teams, agents and their photos stay.
scopeHint.all: All of that plus teams, agents and team leads. You’ll need to upload a file with Teams and Agents again.

wipe.keeps: Never touched: users and permissions, devices, audio and messages, settings, news.
wipe.confirmSales: Permanently delete all targets, sales and deals? A backup downloads first.
wipe.confirmAll: Permanently delete everything, including teams and agents? A backup downloads first.
wipe.done: Cleared: {deals} deals, {sales} sales rows, {targets} targets, {agents} agents, {teams} teams. Upload the new data file now.

importDealsMoved: Deals moved to a new team: {n}.
periodsSalesLocked: Sales are read-only here. Record and edit them from the Deals tab.
